subject: Dedicated capacity demo — BrightSide throughput requirements & scheduling
messages:
From: Amina Hassan <amina@brightside.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in Dedicated capacity for BrightSide AI

Hi Monica,

We signed up for Redwood's hosted API last week (trial) and are very interested in moving to Dedicated capacity for production. Our core inference workload is conversational reranking + short generation for user-facing suggestions. A few quick numbers: 

- Peak concurrent requests: ~30 req/s sustained during business hours, with spikes to ~60 for ~10–15 minutes/day
- Typical prompt size: 150–600 tokens; responses average ~60 tokens
- Desired latency target: p95 < 80ms for the short-generation route; p95 < 120ms for reranking (we can be flexible)
- Throughput requirement for demo: demonstrate ~30 req/s sustained for 30 minutes with representative prompts

We attached our RFP and a token-estimate spreadsheet for the initial sizing. Would like to set up a Dedicated capacity demo focused on throughput/latency and how you handle KV cache and batching for similar workloads. Also happy to share a small sample dataset ahead of time.

Can you propose a couple of demo slots next week? We are PST.

Thanks,
Amina Hassan
Head of ML Engineering
BrightSide AI

Attachments:
- BrightSide-RFP.pdf (pdf)
- token-estimate.xlsx (xlsx)
